caseUseReview.evidence: No client record used; the packet's caseDecisions rationale (retrieved candidates did not overlap) matches the rendered page, which contains no client or survey claim.

conditionsAndCounterexample.evidence: Counterexample (SpaceX uses the charity general-contribution route, so no claim matters) is conceded in text, but the Takeaway omits the seed-eligibility condition and gives a single-stock brokerage directive without a concentration caveat. Findings SX-3 and SX-4.

localExclusions.evidence: No testing, medical or client claim; no first-person test; Allstate layoff rumor and December-for-SpaceX claim excluded as the manifest requires; disclaimer at the bottom of the page.

presentationReview.evidence: Static text plus two finite tables is the right format: inputs do not change the answer and no calculator was needed; the page links the existing Trump Account calculator.

renderedConsistency.evidence: Opening, H2-1, table, FAQ 2 and Takeaway state the same answer (claiming is not shown to be required); metadata promise matches apart from the minor title wording in SX-7.

requestCoverage.evidence: Delivered: claim steps (six) in section 1, active undefined, reported-vs-unconfirmed table, CNBC sale rule attributed, stale "can't be claimed yet" removed and metadata updated. Not yet delivered cleanly: attributions and residual stale statements flagged in SX-1 to SX-4.

sourceAndAssumptions.evidence: Reported basis is mostly traceable to ir.spacex.com note, CNBC and trumpaccounts.gov summaries in research/sources, but the T.D. 10056 donation-mechanics paragraph and the Shotwell-to-Trump-Accounts framing are asserted without a retrieved source (packet: text not retrieved). Findings SX-1 and SX-2.

usefulness.evidence: Page answers the reader question in H2-1 and the table: no source says claiming is required or defines active, claim steps are listed, and a reported-vs-unconfirmed table separates SpaceX release, CNBC and unknowns. It is a source-based reported synthesis; no numerical analysis was needed.
